[[File:Mr. Morita.png|250px|thumb|Mr. Morita]] '''Mr. Morita''' (Japanese: '''モリタ''' ''Morita'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG064|True Blue Swablu]]''. Morita is the {{tc|Pokémon Ranger|Ranger}} of a Pokémon nature preserve located somewhere between [[Verdanturf Town]] and [[Petalburg City]]. He let {{Ash}}, {{an|Brock}}, {{an|May}}, and [[Max]] stay at his home in the preserve while they nursed an injured {{p|Swablu}} back to health and attempted to teach it to fly again. He commended May's efforts when Swablu healed after several days of treatment. Meanwhile, he was able to locate Swablu's flock at a nearby lake. ==Pokémon== ===On hand=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Mr. Morita |pkmn=Nuzleaf |type1=Grass |type2=Dark |img=Mr Morita Nuzleaf.png |epnum=AG064 |epname=True Blue Swablu |desc={{p|Nuzleaf}} is Mr. Morita's partner Pokémon and is usually on his shoulder while the pair work in the nature preserve. None of Nuzleaf's moves are known.}} ===Cared for=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Mr. Morita |pkmn=Swablu |type1=Normal |type2=Flying |img=Mr Morita Swablu.png |epnum=AG064 |epname=True Blue Swablu |vajp=List of Japanese voice actors{{!}}Konami Yoshida |vaen= |desc=After {{p|Swablu}} was separated from its flock due to a thunderstorm, it was found by {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}. Mr. Morita hosted the group at his cabin while they, and in particular {{an|May}}, nursed it back to health until its flock came back. During Swablu's time with the group, it was revealed that it had developed a fear of flying because of the incident. Ash and his friends took care of the problem by having their Pokémon demonstrate the ability while Morita searched for its flock. Morita was driving the group to the lake when his car got a flat tire. It was later revealed that [[James's Cacnea]]'s {{m|Pin Missile}} causes the flat tire as a part of a ploy for {{TRT}} to steal Swablu. Fortunately, Swablu managed to overcome its fear in the end when Team Rocket was defeated. Afterwards, Swablu was returned to its flock when they flew by. Swablu's only known move is {{m|Sing}}.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{normal color}}|bordercolor={{normal color}} |ja=小西克幸 ''[[Katsuyuki Konishi]]'' |en=[[Pete Zarustica]] |fi=Saku Mäkynen |fr_eu=Alexandre Crépet |it=Luca Sandri |pt_br=Dado Monteiro |es_eu=Juan Sainz Maza }}
